dct_description_sm: Freshwater Alexander Bay Ecosystem Corporation (FABEC) is a non-profit Stewardship group based in Glovertown, NL. FABEC conducts freshwater monitoring and other research activities including but not limited to salmonid conservation on four watersheds in the East-Central region of Newfoundland. These watersheds are Terra Nova River, North West Brook, Gambo River, and Middle Brook.
